integrity: The supplied two executable Python programs independently enumerate every feasible deletion subset and every reconfiguration distance; the structural optimum-pair metric additionally has an explicit constructive proof. The known minimum feedback-set classification and general nonminimum fixed-size connectivity are credited, not claimed as novel. No external/independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The metric and component results apply only to the ten-vertex Petersen graph. The size-dependent eccentricities and diametral-pair census are certified by complete finite enumeration and independently implemented checkers, not by an infinite-family theorem. A closely related 2023 journal article was inspected through its public theorem statements and preview, not its unavailable complete text; unindexed older equivalent results remain possible.
title: Petersen feedback-set TAR geodesics and an eccentricity trichotomy
